invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata instance via the execute method, so result should not be null.
The method depends on a non-null instantTime for creating commit metadata, so it likely cannot be null.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata must be generated from hoodieRecords, so hoodieRecords should be non-null.
The JavaUpsertDeltaCommitActionExecutor returns a HoodieWriteMetadata whose list of WriteStatus should not be null.
The size of the list of WriteStatus in the metadata is always non-negative.
